# Manual test cases (generated)

**140 test cases** in 19 areas. Generated by `tools/gen_test_cases.py` - edit the data there, not this file. A CSV copy for test-management tools is in [test_cases.csv](test_cases.csv).

**Priority:** P1 = must pass for a release, P2 = should pass, P3 = nice to have. **Result codes:** PASS · FAIL (file an issue) · BLOCKED · N/A.

| Area | Cases | P1 |
|---|---|---|
| Installation & startup | 11 | 4 |
| Layout & navigation | 8 | 1 |
| Simulation control | 11 | 5 |
| 3D viewport & cameras | 12 | 2 |
| Launch & flight | 7 | 3 |
| Rocket designer | 12 | 5 |
| Survival test | 8 | 3 |
| Flight safety & emergencies | 10 | 3 |
| Orbit analysis | 6 | 2 |

|---|---|---|---|---|

| TC-011 | P1 | **Engine tests pass**<br><sub>Terminal, no GUI</sub> | 1. Run `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v` | All tests pass (no failures/errors) |

## Survival test

| ID | Pri | Title | Steps | Expected result |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| TC-062 | P1 | **Default rocket passes**<br><sub>Default rocket</sub> | 1. Designer > Will it survive? > Run | PASS ('SURVIVED: stable ~199 x 304 km orbit'); margin table shows all margins positive |
| TC-063 | P1 | **Thin wall fails**<br><sub>App started (`python main.py`)</sub> | 1. Set wall thickness 0.5 mm on all stages<br>2. run | FAIL 'VEHICLE LOST ... structural failure (skin stress ... reached yield)' within ~1 s |

| TC-065 | P2 | **Max-Q overload**<br><sub>App started (`python main.py`)</sub> | 1. Max dynamic pressure 15 kPa<br>2. untick autopilot protection in the dialog<br>3. run | FAIL 'aerodynamic overload' |
| TC-066 | P2 | **Cannot lift off**<br><sub>App started (`python main.py`)</sub> | 1. Set engine count 1<br>2. run | Result 'Cannot lift off: sea-level thrust-to-weight is ...' |
| TC-067 | P2 | **Watch in 3D**<br><sub>App started (`python main.py`)</sub> | 1. After a result click 'Watch this launch in 3D' | Main window loads the scenario and plays it with launch camera; failures show breakup animation |

| TC-069 | P3 | **Sounding rocket / SSTO**<br><sub>App started (`python main.py`)</sub> | 1. Run the test on the sounding rocket and the SSTO example | Neither is reported SURVIVED (suborbital / fails to reach orbit) |
